blocksHtml:
• Description

Inspur YZCA-00400-101 4 Port Gigabit Ethernet Network Interface Card delivers enterprise-grade connectivity for servers, workstations, and network appliances. Designed with reliability and performance in mind, this PCIe-based 4-port RJ45 network card is perfect for businesses needing multiple high-speed LAN connections.

Equipped with an Intel-based Gigabit controller, it ensures stable data transfer, low latency, and compatibility with major operating systems, including Windows Server, Linux, and VMware ESXi. Each of its four Gigabit ports supports auto-negotiation, full-duplex, and advanced features such as VLAN tagging, Jumbo Frames, LACP (Link Aggregation), and QoS for efficient traffic management.

This card is ideal for use in virtualization environments, firewall routers, and multi-network setups, providing dependable and scalable networking performance for enterprises and data centers.


Key Features

  • 4 × 10/100/1000 Mbps RJ45 Ethernet ports

  • PCI Express (PCIe x4/x8) interface

  • Intel Gigabit controller for maximum reliability

  • Supports VLAN, Jumbo Frames, LACP, QoS

  • Compatible with Windows, Linux, and VMware

  • Ideal for servers, routers, and network appliances

  • Low-profile and standard brackets are available
